source.title: Call for Applicants: Gear Team Members for WMT (2019)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team is asking for membership applications with the primary task of handling the distribution of WCA Competition Gear. The responsibilities of these team members will be to receive equipment orders, re-pack the equipment for international shipping, and make routine trips to the post office. 

Applicants **must be based within the United States** for this unique position. Otherwise, the applications are open to everyone; it is not a requirement to hold a current position within the WCA to be considered. 
<!-- break -->
The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Ability to accept packages sent to a US address
- Ability to make routine (several times per month) drop-offs to a local post office
- Trustworthiness
- Communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents, which **will be accepted on a rolling basis until all three available positions are filled**. Applications should be sent privately to the Somya Srivastava ([ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
- Brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done for the WCA
- Ambitions as a member of the WCA Marketing Team

Upon receipt, it will be confirmed if the documents are in good order or if there are deficiencies.

The rights and duties of the WMT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WMT leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组器材组成员招募（2019 年）
translation.content:
WCA 市场营销组现招募新成员，主要负责 WCA 比赛器材的发货。工作包括接收器材订单、为国际运输重新包装器材，以及定期前往邮局寄件。

由于岗位特殊，申请人**必须居住在美国**。除此之外，申请面向所有人，无须目前在 WCA 担任职务。

申请人应具备以下条件：

- 能够在美国地址接收包裹
- 能够定期前往当地邮局寄件，每月数次
- 诚实可靠
- 良好的沟通能力

现已开始接收申请，**将持续招募，直至三个名额全部录满**。请将材料私下发送给 Somya Srivastava（[ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 简短的个人介绍
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
- 担任 WCA 市场营销组成员的工作设想

收到申请后，我们会确认材料是否完整，或指出需要补充之处。

WMT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WMT 负责人将选出人选；待候选人接受职位后，将公布新成员。

提前感谢各位申请和支持！
